description: Eval set for triggering accuracy and output quality. Skill should trigger on any structured document production request. Also tests composition with tech-reviewer and data-platform-architect.

cases.prompt: Write a requirements brief for use-case-1.
cases.expected_behaviour: Skill loads. Claude identifies audience and document type before writing. Applies conclusion-first structure. Includes version, author, and date fields.

assertions.value: conclusion or objective stated at top of document

cases.prompt: Draft an ADR for the storage account design decision.
cases.expected_behaviour: Skill loads. Claude uses the ADR template from references/templates.md. Structure: context / decision / consequences only. Concise.

cases.prompt: Create a runbook for the forecasting pipeline deployment.
cases.expected_behaviour: Skill loads. Claude uses the Runbook template from references/templates.md. Numbered steps, operator-executable, no ambiguity. Does NOT lead with conclusion — follows task sequence.

assertions.value: conclusion or recommendation placed at top
assertions.description: Runbook follows task sequence, not conclusion-first

cases.prompt: Turn these meeting notes into a reference doc.
cases.expected_behaviour: Skill loads. Claude identifies document type as reference (scannable). Uses tables and short paragraphs. Selects appropriate output format.

assertions.value: document type identified as reference before writing
output uses tables or short paragraphs for scannability

cases.prompt: Fix the formatting on this markdown file.
cases.expected_behaviour: Skill loads. Claude reads references/markdown-formatting.md before editing. Applies table alignment, blank-line rules, code fences.

assertions.value: blank lines added before and after tables
code blocks fenced with language identifier

cases.prompt: Write a setup guide for the Filesystem MCP — technically verified
cases.expected_behaviour: Both doc-writer AND tech-reviewer load. Claude reads markdown-formatting.md (doc-writer) and fetches official source (tech-reviewer) before writing.

assertions.value: official source fetched before any technical claim written

cases.prompt: What is the difference between DLT and Workflows on Databricks?
cases.expected_behaviour: Skill does NOT load. This is a factual question, not a document production request. Claude answers conversationally.

assertions.description: No document structure or template applied
Response is conversational, not structured document

cases.expected_behaviour: Skill does NOT load. Summarisation is not structured document production — no document type, no saved output implied.

assertions.description: No document type identification or template loading

assertions.value: summary delivered inline without document framing
assertions.description: Response is a summary, not a structured document
